game-dust-on-the-river.intro: Dust on the River is an Australian historical life game set in a fictional north-east Victorian river town in the 1890s. You arrive under a new name, take station work, ride, fish and pan for gold while a past tied to bushranger Red Jack starts to catch up.

details.heading: A frontier story in Victoria
details.text: The story is set in Crossing, a fictional town inspired by Victorian goldfields, railway towns and high-country settlements. It follows a former bushranger trying to make a new life through ordinary work and relationships with townspeople.

details.heading: Work, ride and explore
details.text: Take station jobs, move livestock, ride between Crossing and nearby stations, fish and pan for gold in the Android game. Play in your browser on Wavedash, or find the Android version on Google Play. The older itch.io browser build remains unfinished.

faqs.question: Where can I play?
faqs.answer: Play in your browser on Wavedash or find the Android version on Google Play. The older itch.io browser build remains unfinished.

updates.dateMeaning: Google Play listing's displayed update date
updates.title: Android listing notes new work and Crossing polish
updates.summary: The Android update notes cover Station Agent work, a golden trail to Redgum, softer roads, rain puddles, wet footsteps, dust trails, lighting changes, horse naming and clearer first-ride guidance.

updates.title: v2.7 WIP update
updates.summary: This WIP update covers foliage, riverbanks, gold dust and polish around Crossing.

relatedLabels.book-dust-on-the-river: Read the separate Dust on the River novel

game-drink.intro: Drink is a short, top-down narrative game about alcohol dependence, avoidance and the beginning of accountability. Its fixed story follows a person through a small town where drinking brings short-term relief and consequences accumulate.

details.heading: A contained story with one ending
details.text: Money is limited, dialogue is sparse, and your choices carry consequences. The story has one fixed ending, focused on accountability rather than recovery. It deals with alcohol dependence, denial, avoidance and shame.

details.heading: The game and its related works
details.text: The story continues in Sober, a separate novel set after the game. You can also listen to Drink (Original Soundtrack) as its own album.

faqs.question: What should players know about the subject matter?
faqs.answer: The game depicts alcohol use and deals with dependence, denial, avoidance, shame and accountability. These themes may be uncomfortable for some players. The Google Play content rating includes use of alcohol.

faqs.question: What platforms are available?
faqs.answer: Play in a browser or download for Windows on itch.io. The Android game is on Google Play, and the mobile and Steam versions include controller support. Check the relevant store for the version you're choosing.

updates.dateMeaning: Google Play listing's displayed update date
updates.title: Android SDK update
updates.summary: The Android update brings the app onto the latest Android SDK available at the time.

relatedLabels.music-drink-ost: Listen to the Drink original soundtrack

game-possum-cafe.intro: Night Shift at Possum's Café is a cosy pixel-art café game about serving animal customers as a possum barista. Prepare simple drinks and treats, keep orders moving through quiet moments and rushes, and gradually make the neighbourhood café busier and more inviting.

details.heading: A small café and short shifts
details.text: Run one Australian-inspired night café through short, replayable shifts. Serve flat whites, tea, hot chocolate, croissants and cake, with a gentle atmosphere rather than complicated management systems.

details.heading: One game across two store names
details.text: On Google Play, you'll find the game as Possum Café: Cosy Barista Game. Night Shift at Possum's Café is the same possum-barista game. The Android version contains ads.

faqs.question: What do you do in the game?
faqs.answer: Prepare drinks and treats for animal customers, including flat whites, tea, hot chocolate, pastries and cake. The Android game also includes small upgrades and timed service.

faqs.question: Is the Android version ad-free?
faqs.answer: No. The Android version contains ads. Check Google Play for current details.

updates.dateMeaning: Google Play listing's displayed update date
updates.title: A gentler first night
updates.summary: The Android update notes cover a guided two-order opening, a longer and more forgiving first shift, a clearer mobile café layout and a small after-close story teaser.

game-the-last-guard.seoTitle: The Last Guard browser fortress defence game
game-the-last-guard.intro: The Last Guard is a first-person browser wall-defence survival game. Aim a mounted gun against a fantasy horde, manage heat, call support and bank scrap to improve your chances between stands.

details.heading: Hold the wall
details.text: Keep your mounted gun firing without overheating, and use emergency cooling when the horde closes in. Buy weapons, explosive ammunition and defences, call in artillery, and carry your upgrades into the next run.

details.heading: Browser controls and local progress
details.text: Play with mouse, keyboard or touch. Controller support is experimental. Progress saves locally in your browser, with no account required.

faqs.question: Does the game save progress?
faqs.answer: Yes. Your progress saves locally in the browser. You don't need an account.

faqs.question: Are all army sizes ordinary play profiles?
faqs.answer: No. Choose 2k, 6k or 14k for ordinary play. The 28k and 40k options are stress tests.

updates.title: Alpha.20 on Wavedash
updates.summary: The Wavedash listing identifies the current build as Alpha.20, with touch controls, steep aim and cooling settings.

updates.title: The Last Guard joins Wavedash as a free browser game
updates.summary: The Last Guard is available to play free in the browser on Wavedash. Defend the fortress wall against a huge orc horde, manage a belt-fed gun's heat, call artillery and spend banked scrap on better weapons and defences. The 2k, 6k and 14k army settings are normal play profiles; 28k and 40k are stress tests. Keyboard, mouse and touch controls are supported; controllers remain experimental.

updates.title: Alpha.15: Reliability and accessibility update
updates.summary: Alpha.15 improves loading, touch input, keyboard and controller navigation, and safe resume after switching away. New options include remappable keys, per-device aiming settings, mirrored touch controls, toggle-to-fire and larger UI and text. Physical Android performance remains unverified.

relatedLabels.game-briarhold: Explore Briarhold action-defence and co-op testing

game-the-horde.intro: The Horde 1.6.2 is a native Vulkan hardware ray-tracing tomb demo for Windows and compatible Android phones. Explore a torch-lit gothic ruin, fight skeletons and confront the Lich, with reflective water, an adaptive soundtrack and a new lantern-lit menu.

details.heading: A technology showcase, not a complete game
details.text: The Horde is a focused technology demo, not a complete game. Its renderer uses native Vulkan acceleration structures and ray-tracing commands. There is no raster, browser, baked, screen-space or simulated ray-tracing fallback.

details.heading: Graphics you can preview and keep
details.text: A live ray-traced Graphics preview lets you compare render scale, water, fire, glass, mist and dust before keeping or restoring your settings. New Android installs start at 50% render scale with Mobile water and fire, glass off, mist on and Low dust. Windows starts at 100%, High water and fire, glass on, mist on and Low dust. Existing settings are preserved; 33% and 40% scales are experimental.

details.heading: Touch controls, controllers and the tomb
details.text: Swing, Parry and Dodge touch buttons accompany a heart-based health display. Android controller support covers menus, gameplay and reconnects. The sword starts sheathed and draws at the waterfall guards, with improved equipment clearance. The update also adds subtle dust, torch-lit waterfall refinements, a closed base beneath the grate and collision for the Keeper’s torch stands.

details.heading: Hardware and testing limits
details.text: Windows requires Windows 10/11 and a Vulkan-capable hardware ray-tracing GPU. The published 1.6.2 build has recorded checks on a Galaxy S26 Ultra and an RTX 5050 Laptop GPU. Earlier S24 Ultra testing does not certify this release on every device; S25 Ultra remains unverified. Backbone One PlayStation Edition USB-C is the tested Android controller, with other combinations still needing coverage. Sustained 30 FPS is not guaranteed. Combat remains forgiving: a hit can register before exact visible blade contact.

faqs.question: Can I play this in a browser?
faqs.answer: No. This is a native Windows and Android demo, with no browser or simulated ray-tracing fallback.

faqs.question: Will it run on my Android phone?
faqs.answer: Your phone needs the required Vulkan hardware ray-tracing features. Version 1.6.2 was checked on a Galaxy S26 Ultra. Earlier testing covered the S24 Ultra; S25 Ultra compatibility is expected but still needs physical testing. Performance depends on your device and settings.

faqs.question: Where can I get version 1.6.2?
faqs.answer: Download the Windows build or Android APK from the official itch.io page. Version 1.6.2 is published there; the GitHub repository provides source and technical documentation.

updates.title: 1.6.2: Finishing the tomb
updates.summary: Now available for Windows and Android, 1.6.2 adds a lantern-lit menu, live graphics preview, reworked touch controls and Android controller support. Equipment clearance, waterfall lighting and dungeon details are improved. Saved settings are preserved. Combat remains forgiving, and sustained phone frame rates are not guaranteed.

updates.title: Showcase Alpha 1.6.1
updates.summary: The engineering update adds dedicated ray-traced viewmodel arms and a separately owned player body, adaptive music with separate audio controls, consent-based in-game reporting, and resource and lifecycle improvements. The release is available for Windows and Android.

game-bug-swarm.intro: Bug Swarm is a phone-oriented tower-defence prototype. Place towers beside a curved dirt-tray path and respond as waves of bugs flood through it. Start with Leaf 1k; the larger prototype levels begin locked.

details.text: Build DIY towers beside the dirt-tray maze and use Poke and Burn to deal with ants, roaches and beetles. Spend Bug Bucks and Rare Parts on the workbench upgrade tree.
details.heading: Build beside the bug path

details.text: Leaf 1k is available from the start. Biscuit 2.5k, Crayon 5k, Button 7.5k and Toybox 10k begin locked. These are prototype flood levels, not promises of supported phone performance at those swarm sizes. Lab mode is a separate browser stress test.
details.heading: Prototype levels and stress tests

faqs.question: How do I place towers and use tools?
faqs.answer: Select a tower and tap beside the path to place it. During a flood, select Poke or Burn and use it on the bugs.

faqs.question: Are all five flood levels unlocked?
faqs.answer: No. Leaf 1k is available by default; the larger prototype levels begin locked. Lab mode is a separate browser stress test.

game-cursed-cutter.intro: Cursed Cutter is a pocket roguelite garden-horror game, also titled Curse Cutter: Last Garden in-game. Play as an armoured groundskeeper, cut five cursed beds before they regrow, survive rootlings and seal the Rootgate before midnight.

details.text: Clear five cursed beds, fight off rootlings and reach the centre to seal the exposed Rootgate. Watch the countdown to midnight, your armour and the spool charge you need to keep cutting.
details.heading: Clear the garden and close the Rootgate

details.text: On touch screens, use the joystick, CUT and DODGE controls. Desktop controls include WASD, Space, Shift and mouse orbit. Root shards and workshop upgrades carry between shifts, while graphics, music, sound and camera-follow settings save on your device. The game uses Babylon.js with WebGPU and WebGL support.
details.heading: Runs, upgrades and controls

faqs.question: Why does the game appear under two names?
faqs.answer: Cursed Cutter is the name used here. You'll see Curse Cutter: Last Garden in the browser title and Curse Cutter in the game logo. All three refer to this same browser game.

faqs.question: How do I finish a shift?
faqs.answer: Clear the five beds, survive the rootlings and stand in the exposed Rootgate ring while holding CUT to seal it before midnight.

app-what-would-win.intro: One horse-sized duck or a hundred duck-sized horses? Pick a suggested matchup or build your own, set the scene, and read the battle story. The model estimates who wins; the written account explains why.

details.heading: Read the battle, then change the odds
details.text: Follow the opening, turning point and finish, with the reasons behind the result and the other side's best chance. The story is an illustrative reconstruction, not a replay of an individual trial. Change the environment, double the group or try the model's approximate 50/50 group size when one is available.

details.heading: A simulator, not a prediction authority
details.text: Creature profiles, sizes, abilities and battlefield conditions shape the numerical result. The story explains that result without choosing or changing the winner. Every percentage is an estimate in this entertainment model, not a real-world prediction. Deep dive keeps the detailed calculations and sources available.

details.heading: Custom profiles and reproducible shares
details.text: Save private custom creature profiles and share reproducible matchups with versioned links. The project documentation explains the simulation and data model; the app's current explanation shows how a particular matchup is modelled.

faqs.question: Does AI text decide who wins?
faqs.answer: No. The numerical engine determines the outcome. Generated text does not choose or change the winner.

faqs.question: Should I treat a result as a scientific prediction?
faqs.answer: No. This is a creature matchup simulator, not a validated scientific predictor of real-world outcomes.

updates.title: 0.9.1: Written battles, presets and next experiments
updates.summary: Suggested matchups now lead Simple mode, followed by a full matchup verdict and a written opening, turning point and finish. Percentages are labelled as model estimates. Change the environment, double the group or try an approximate 50/50 group size when available. The animated battle view is retired. Model 0.5.0, data 0.6.0, profiles, saves and share formats are unchanged.

app-pocket-chordsmith.intro: Pocket Chordsmith is a browser music sketchpad for building chord progressions, beats, bass, melodies, guitar parts, loops and longer song ideas. It offers a quick mode and a deeper arrangement mode, with exports for continuing work elsewhere.

details.heading: Sketch and arrange
details.text: Write chords, drums, bass, melody and guitar parts, then arrange sections into a longer song. Advanced tools include MIDI import and export, WAV export, JSON projects and PCS1 share codes.

details.heading: Browser audio and licensing
details.text: Pocket Chordsmith runs in your browser with lightweight Web Audio instruments. Performance and audio behaviour vary by device and browser. The app's source is public, but it does not have a published app licence. The separate Godot addon has its own MIT licence.

faqs.question: What can I export?
faqs.answer: Export compact JSON, PCS1 share codes, MIDI or WAV. You can also import MIDI in Advanced mode.

faqs.question: Does it run in a browser?
faqs.answer: Yes. It uses Web Audio instruments in your browser. Tap Play once to unlock audio, and bear in mind that performance and audio behaviour can vary between devices and browsers.

updates.title: v70: Campfire guitar and passage comparisons
updates.summary: Campfire Acoustic adds major and minor guitar voicings, strumming and picking controls, and MIDI/WAV export. Preview a passage with Hear this bit, compare a proposed performance change with the original, then Apply or Discard. Three optional themes join playback and Undo fixes. Mixing Campfire and amp sections is supported in offline WAV export, but not yet in live playback.

updates.title: v68 Core bridge and WAV export
updates.summary: The v68 update adds a Pocket Audio Core bridge for local project loading and timeline diagnostics, mirrors transport start and stop when the module is available, and tries Core-first WAV rendering with the existing offline renderer as fallback.

updates.title: Pocket Chordsmith v63
updates.summary: The v63 devlog covers MIDI import, rock guitar, song sections and random ideas.

relatedLabels.app-pocket-dj: Perform Chordsmith songs in Pocket DJ
relatedLabels.app-pocket-daw: Arrange songs in Pocket DAW for Windows
relatedLabels.app-pocket-audio-handoff: Transfer song data with Pocket Audio Handoff

asset-pocket-chordsmith-godot.intro: Bring Pocket Chordsmith songs into Godot with JSON or PCS1 share codes. This community addon is listed for Godot 4.4 under the MIT licence. That licence covers the addon, not the whole Pocket Audio family.

details.heading: Bring song structure into a Godot project
details.text: Compile song data into Godot chart resources, with beat, bar and section timing, adaptive music states, markers and cues. Use Godot-native sample or stem playback at runtime.

details.heading: Addon licensing is distinct
details.text: The addon is MIT licensed. Other Pocket Audio components use different licences, so check the licence for each app, asset or piece of code before reusing it.

faqs.question: What input formats does it accept?
faqs.answer: Import Pocket Chordsmith JSON or PCS1 share codes.

faqs.question: Does the MIT license cover Pocket Chordsmith itself?
faqs.answer: No. The MIT licence covers this Godot addon. Other Pocket Audio components have their own licensing terms.

updates.dateMeaning: GitHub and itch addon release date
updates.title: 1.3.0 - prepared Core and native DAW audio
updates.summary: Version1.3.0 adds prepared Core/Campfire audio and fully arranged native DAW-export playback. Validated on Godot4.6.3 Windows/WASAPI, with both human listening checks passed. Historical intermittent stalls were not reproduced; cause unknown. Dummy timing and whole-run frame limits remain documented. Store and Asset Library updates are separate.

updates.title: Pocket Chordsmith addon listing
updates.summary: The Godot Asset Library lists Pocket Chordsmith 1.2.0 for Godot 4.4 and shows a submission date of July 23, 2026.

app-pocket-audio-handoff.intro: Pocket Audio Handoff is a browser helper for moving Pocket Chordsmith PCS1 song data between a phone, Pocket DAW on desktop and the Godot addon. It supports short transfer codes, with copy and file handoff options also available.

details.heading: Move a song between tools
details.text: Move Pocket Chordsmith PCS1 song data using a short code, copy it directly or use a file. You can also hand a song over to Pocket DAW. Handoff transfers your music between tools; it doesn't replace the composer or DAW.

details.heading: Use the current helper route
details.text: Open the helper at /apps/pocket-audio-handoff/ to transfer song data. Its transfer links belong to the handoff workflow, rather than being app downloads or standalone tracks.

faqs.question: What can I transfer?
faqs.answer: Pocket Chordsmith PCS1 song data, using a short code, copy or file.

faqs.question: Does it replace Pocket Chordsmith or Pocket DAW?
faqs.answer: No. Handoff moves song data between the tools. Write the song in Chordsmith and continue working on it in the separate Pocket DAW desktop app.

relatedLabels.app-pocket-chordsmith: Make a song in Pocket Chordsmith
relatedLabels.asset-pocket-chordsmith-godot: Use the Godot addon for game audio

game-bug-maze-td.intro: Bug Maze TD is a portrait-first tower-defence game for mobile browsers. Build paths and place bug-themed towers across handcrafted garden levels, while ground and flying enemies follow different routes.

details.heading: Build a maze through the garden
details.text: Build through four handcrafted garden levels with different enemies, tower roles, themes and music. Change the game speed, or save your run and continue later.

details.heading: The Android link is a collection
details.text: On Android, Bug Maze TD is included in Samfa12 Tower Defense Pack. The Google Play link opens that collection, not a standalone Bug Maze TD app.

faqs.question: Can ground and flying enemies be blocked by the same maze?
faqs.answer: No. Ground enemies find a path around your maze, while flying enemies head straight through.

faqs.question: Is the Google Play link a separate Bug Maze TD app?
faqs.answer: No. It opens Samfa12 Tower Defense Pack, which includes Bug Maze TD alongside other tower-defence games.

game-breakfast-beat.intro: Breakfast Beat is a rhythm-infused tower-defence game set on a breakfast line. Place food-themed defences against incoming snack waves; lanes map to chord notes and tower columns fire in sequence, turning a defence layout into a musical grid.

details.heading: Defend in time with the music
details.text: Place Egg Shakers, Toast Stacks, Yolk Bombs and Bacon Blasters, and choose the chords behind your defence. Survive twelve waves to unlock Endless Mode.

details.heading: Included in the Android pack
details.text: Play Breakfast Beat on Android as part of Samfa12 Tower Defense Pack. The Google Play link opens the collection, not a separate Breakfast Beat app.

faqs.question: How does music relate to the tower defence?
faqs.answer: Each lane is a chord note and each column fires on a step in the sequence. Your tower placement creates the musical pattern.

faqs.question: Where can I play on Android?
faqs.answer: You'll find it in Samfa12 Tower Defense Pack on Google Play, rather than as a standalone Android app.

game-ship-blockade.intro: Ship Blockade is a lane-based arcade tower-defence game about stopping ships from breaking through a shipping lane. Place guns, mines, missile batteries and blocker boats, adapting as faster and more heavily armoured vessels arrive.

details.heading: Build while the pressure rises
details.text: Place defences during a wave, allowing for their build delay, then upgrade towers between waves. This is still an early prototype focused on gameplay and balance, despite itch.io's Released label.

details.heading: Included in the Android pack
details.text: On Android, Ship Blockade is part of Samfa12 Tower Defense Pack. The Google Play link opens the collection.

faqs.question: Is Ship Blockade a finished game?
faqs.answer: No. It's an early prototype focused on gameplay and balance. The Released label on itch.io doesn't mean development is finished.

faqs.question: Can I get it from Google Play by itself?
faqs.answer: The linked Google Play download is Samfa12 Tower Defense Pack. A separate Android download for Ship Blockade has not been verified.

game-hop-bunny.intro: Hop Bunny is a precision jumping game: charge a jump, release at the right moment and try to reach a target height. Its handcrafted phases grow in scale, with collectibles, hazards, combo scoring and a carrot-moon finale.

details.heading: A timing challenge
details.text: Charge a jump, release it at the right moment and learn to steer in the air as you progress. Play this HTML5 platformer with keyboard, mouse or touch, accompanied by original music.

faqs.question: How do you jump?
faqs.answer: Hold the HOP control to charge, then release to jump. The aim is to land as close as possible to the target height.

game-pocket-pattern.intro: Pocket Pattern is a tactile 3D sliding puzzle you can play in a browser. Shake a miniature cube to make a 3×3 colour target, then slide tiles around the large board until its centre matches. Each round measures your time and tile moves.

details.heading: Shake a target, then solve the centre
details.text: Shake the miniature cube for a random 3×3 colour target. Slide tiles into the empty space until the centre of the larger board matches it. Tiles in the same row or column as the gap can be pushed together.

details.heading: Browser play, controls and scoring
details.text: Play on a phone, tablet or desktop browser with touch, drag or mouse controls. Track your time, individual tile slides and local personal bests. Colour symbols, optional vibration on supported devices, and music, sound, graphics and motion settings let you adjust the experience.

details.heading: Music from Pocket Chordsmith
details.text: The game's original music was made with Pocket Chordsmith, my separate browser music tool.

faqs.question: Where can I play Pocket Pattern?
faqs.answer: Play in your browser on itch.io. No download is required.

faqs.question: Can I move several tiles at once?
faqs.answer: Yes. Tiles in the same row or column as the empty space can be pushed together, but each tile moved one space counts as one slide toward your score.

updates.title: Pocket Pattern playable on itch.io
updates.summary: Pocket Pattern arrived on itch.io as an HTML5 sliding puzzle you can play in your browser.

relatedLabels.app-pocket-chordsmith: Explore Pocket Chordsmith, used to create the music

game-reckless-dentist.intro: Reckless Dentist is a short browser score-attack game about treating cartoon teeth at speed. Spot the problem and drag the right tool into place while the clinic grows more chaotic.

details.heading: Fast dental microgames
details.text: Clean, fill and extract cartoon teeth in Shift Mode or Patient Mode. Drag tools with mouse or touch, and try to beat your best score, saved locally in the browser.

details.heading: Cartoon comedy
details.text: Expect silly cartoon mouths and synthetic comedy sound effects. There's no blood or realistic dentistry.

faqs.question: How do the controls work?
faqs.answer: Use mouse or touch to select a tool and drag it to the affected tooth.

faqs.question: Does the browser save a score?
faqs.answer: Yes. Your best score saves locally in the browser.

game-gremlin-grenade-pinball.intro: Gremlin Grenade Pinball is a prototype that combines pinball with a gremlin horde. Keep a live grenade moving with the flippers, hit traps and stop gremlins advancing down the board. It's still in development.

details.heading: Prototype features and plans
details.text: Use the spring launcher, flippers, bumpers and trap targets against gremlins moving down the board. Five themed boards and further features are planned or in development; they are not all confirmed complete.

faqs.question: Are all five listed boards complete?
faqs.answer: No complete five-board release has been confirmed. The game is a prototype, with those boards still described as planned or in development.

game-wonky-vehicle-lab.intro: Wonky Vehicle Lab is a prototype vehicle-building sandbox for drawing odd machines and testing them on a bumpy physics track. Sketch parts, connect them with glue or welds, then drive and see whether the design reaches the finish.

details.heading: Draw, build and test
details.text: Draw frames, struts, wheels and seats, join them together, then take your invention onto the track. Share builds with WVL1 codes. The HTML5 prototype has keyboard, mouse and touch inputs, and its code is MIT licensed.

details.heading: A prototype with usability work remaining
details.text: This is a prototype. Earlier player feedback identified poor mobile scaling, and current mobile usability still needs checking.

faqs.question: Can I share a vehicle design?
faqs.answer: Yes. Copy and paste WVL1 build codes to share your inventions.

game-td-pack.intro: Samfa12 Tower Defense Pack brings bite-sized tower-defence games together on Android. Breakfast Beat, Ship Blockade, Bug Maze TD, Coop Guard TD and Library Lockdown TD each have their own theme, towers, enemies and music.

details.heading: A collection of tower-defence games
details.text: Play short levels offline, with a shared launcher, settings and audio controls. The pack has no ads, accounts or data collection. Google Play currently names five games but refers to six in its What's New note, so the total included-game count still needs clarification.

faqs.question: Which games are included?
faqs.answer: The named games are Breakfast Beat, Ship Blockade, Bug Maze TD, Coop Guard TD and Library Lockdown TD. Google Play's What's New note refers to six games, which conflicts with that five-title list; the total count is unresolved.

faqs.question: Are the constituent itch games separate Android store pages?
faqs.answer: No. The Google Play links for Breakfast Beat, Ship Blockade and Bug Maze TD open this collection, rather than individual Android apps.

game-lofi-and-chill-pack.intro: Samfa12's Lofi and Chill Pack is an Android collection of calm, low-pressure scenes with soft lofi music and voxel-style visuals. Spend a little time with fish, ants, birds, a train set, a koi pond or Moon Mower.

details.heading: A collection of pocket worlds
details.text: Explore Voxel Fish Tank, Pocket Ant Farm, Pocket Aviary, Pocket Train Set, Pocket Koi Pond and Moon Mower. These mobile-first scenes have graphics settings and suit short, relaxed sessions. The collection is growing, so its selection may change.

details.heading: Android collection and browser games
details.text: The Google Play download contains the collection. Pocket Fish Tank, Pocket Ant Farm and Moon Mower also have their own browser pages on itch.io; they aren't separate Android apps at that Play link.

faqs.question: What's in the pack?
faqs.answer: Voxel Fish Tank, Pocket Ant Farm, Pocket Aviary, Pocket Train Set, Pocket Koi Pond and Moon Mower are currently named in the collection. The selection may change as the pack grows.

faqs.question: Is there a separate Play app for each named scene?
faqs.answer: The Google Play link opens one collection app. Some experiences also have their own browser pages on itch.io.

updates.dateMeaning: Google Play listing's displayed update date
updates.title: Lofi and Chill Pack listing updated
updates.summary: The 29 August Google Play update notes describe further optimisations and refinements.

game-spin-vector.intro: Pilot an upgradeable vector drone through Spin Vector's neon arcade arenas. Fight waves of enemies, face bosses and bank credits for permanent upgrades. The Android game also includes post-game Gauntlet and Adventure modes.

details.heading: Arena combat and upgrades
details.text: The Android game has ten themed arenas with twelve waves each. Face mini-bosses on waves six and nine, then a main boss on wave twelve. Spend credits on permanent ship upgrades, unlock Gauntlet and reach the post-game Adventure hub after clearing the arenas.

details.heading: Adaptive music
details.text: Spin Vector's adaptive music runs on my Pocket Chordsmith engine. For Android, use the current Google Play release; the itch description still contains older closed-testing wording.

faqs.question: How many arenas are in the Android game?
faqs.answer: Ten themed arenas, each with twelve waves, mini-bosses and a main boss.

faqs.question: Is the music generated adaptively?
faqs.answer: The game uses adaptive music powered by the Pocket Chordsmith engine.

updates.dateMeaning: Google Play listing's displayed update date
updates.title: Smaller Android download
updates.summary: The Android update notes describe a smaller, leaner build after removing unused code and resources, with gameplay, visuals, controls, saves, music and achievements unchanged.

game-mandible-wars.intro: Mandible Wars is an early playable, portrait-first RTS-lite about ants and termites fighting over a large patch of dirt. Command squads, scout through fog of war, gather nectar, build a colony and capture strongpoints on grid-based battlefields.

details.heading: Two modes and competing colonies
details.text: Capture and hold strongpoints in Pheromone Conquest, or destroy the opposing colony in Colony War. Controls are designed around phones, with desktop support too.

details.heading: A playable build in development
details.text: This is an early playable build. I'd love feedback on controls, balance, bugs, readability and mobile play. The features here describe the current prototype rather than a promised final release.

faqs.question: Which factions can I command?
faqs.answer: You can command Ants or Termites.

faqs.question: What are the game modes?
faqs.answer: Pheromone Conquest focuses on capturing strongpoints; Colony War focuses on destroying the opposing colony.

game-moon-mower.intro: Moon Mower is a cosy-comic arcade game about a tiny astronaut mowing a glowing, overgrown moon. Cut paths through lunar grass, rescue trapped spirits, build combos and chase a score before time runs out.

details.heading: Automatic mowing, movement-led play
details.text: Mowing happens automatically as you move. Steer, boost and chase a score, then jump straight back in for another few-minute session. The released HTML5 game includes graphics settings.

details.heading: Included in Lofi and Chill Pack
details.text: On Android, Moon Mower is part of Lofi and Chill Pack. The itch.io page is for the individual browser game.

faqs.question: Is mowing controlled by a separate tool button?
faqs.answer: No. Mowing is automatic as you move. You steer, boost, free spirits and chase a score.

faqs.question: What does the Android link open?
faqs.answer: It opens Lofi and Chill Pack, which includes Moon Mower, rather than a standalone Android Moon Mower app.

game-pocket-fish-tank.intro: Pocket Fish Tank is a calm aquarium toy. Decorate a voxel tank, add water and watch fish and other small creatures settle in. You may also see it called Fish Tank on itch.io.

details.heading: Create a quiet aquarium
details.text: Fill your tank with plants, coral, pebbles, lights and castles, then add fish, crabs, snails and shrimp. There is no score or fail state. The game uses Babylon.js, with WebGPU support where available.

details.heading: Browser and desktop files, plus a collection listing
details.text: Find browser play and Windows, macOS and Linux files on itch.io. The Android link opens Lofi and Chill Pack, which includes a Voxel Fish Tank experience, rather than a standalone Pocket Fish Tank app.

faqs.question: Can the aquarium fail?
faqs.answer: No. There's no score and no fail state. It's a quiet aquarium to arrange and watch.

faqs.question: Does the Play link go to a standalone fish tank app?
faqs.answer: No. It opens Lofi and Chill Pack, which includes Voxel Fish Tank.

game-party-bus.intro: P.A.R.T.Y. Bus: Wasteland Run is a 3D browser driving-survival prototype about taking a battered yellow bus into hostile territory and getting survivors and supplies back to base. Damage, cargo weight, enemies and fuel all add pressure to the return trip.

details.heading: Scavenge and bring people home
details.text: In the v0.9 prototype, drive the Rust Mile, scavenge scrap and fuel, rescue survivors and face hostile encounters. Choose when to turn back, then get everyone home. The bus has visible upgrades, with desktop and mobile touch controls.

details.heading: Prototype status
details.text: This is an in-development browser prototype. Future roadmap features are not confirmed parts of the playable build.

faqs.question: Can I choose when to head back?
faqs.answer: Yes. Turn back manually when you're ready, then survive the ride home.

faqs.question: Is this a finished release?
faqs.answer: No. The current described build is the v0.9 browser prototype.

game-pocket-ant-farm.intro: Pocket Ant Farm is a relaxing voxel ant-colony simulation in a glass-sided dirt slab. Watch ants dig, explore and forage; drop food, suggest digging areas and make the soil translucent to see the tunnels.

details.heading: An observation toy in an early build
details.text: Start with one ant and add workers to grow a small colony. This prototype is about atmosphere and observation rather than winning or losing. Portrait mode is recommended on phone, tablet or desktop browser.

details.heading: Included in Lofi and Chill Pack
details.text: On Android, Pocket Ant Farm is included in Lofi and Chill Pack. The Google Play link opens that collection, not an individual Pocket Ant Farm app.

faqs.question: Can I control where ants dig?
faqs.answer: Tap the farm to place dig hints and drop food. The ants dig and explore within the simulation.

faqs.question: Is Pocket Ant Farm a standalone Play Store app?
faqs.answer: The linked Android download is Lofi and Chill Pack, which includes Pocket Ant Farm.

game-briarhold.intro: Briarhold is a first-person action-defence roguelite with browser and Android Alpha.103 testing builds. Prepare and reclaim authored defences, time your cooling, and fight the Briar Host. Multiplayer co-op remains experimental.

details.heading: Defend the fortress
details.text: Briarhold is a first-person action-defence roguelite with repairable defences prepared during daytime. Alpha.103 adds timed active cooling, twelve authored defence sites, mechanical ballista articulation with exclusive upgrade branches, daytime reclaim and replacement, and a directional gate rack with one manual discharge per night. Browser play and Android testing use separate destinations.

details.heading: Co-op is experimental
details.text: Multiplayer co-op remains experimental. Both players should use the same Alpha.103 build. Two-phone and cross-network play, sustained performance, guest cooling and shared automatic medicine consumption remain active test areas; the intermittent Night 5 freeze is still under investigation.

details.heading: Android recovery and testing
details.text: An intermittent Android WebView crash remains under investigation. If the renderer stops, a recovery prompt can restart Briarhold from saved progress. This recovery does not establish that the underlying crash is fixed.

faqs.question: Where can I try Briarhold?
faqs.answer: Play in your browser, or visit the separate Briarhold testing page for Android downloads and current updater details.

faqs.question: Is multiplayer co-op finished?
faqs.answer: No. Multiplayer co-op is experimental.

updates.title: Briarhold Alpha.103
updates.summary: Alpha.103 adds authored field defences, mechanical ballista controls and upgrade choices, a directional gate rack, and daytime reclaim/replacement. Short taps on Fire perform active cooling; prepared medicine automatically helps a living Warden at 10% Health or below, once per night. Co-op recovery and guest defence choices are corrected, with improved compact touch layouts and release asset identities. Both co-op players should update. The intermittent Android WebView crash and separate earlier Night5 freeze remain unresolved; physical and cross-network playtesting continues.

updates.title: Briarhold Alpha.102
updates.summary: Alpha.102 improves NPC arm and hand poses, woodland behind the fortress and west stair handrail landings. Ashwing is easier to see and target, locks dives toward the player after a warning, and leaves clearer ash hazards. Dive warnings follow the actual approach path, including diagonal dives. Phone rendering is sharper. An intermittent Android WebView crash remains under investigation; the recovery prompt can restart from saved progress. Both co-op players should update.

updates.title: Briarhold Alpha.101
updates.summary: The release notes describe fixes for recurring Mason repair and New Run freezes, improvements to auto-fire and enemy presentation, and co-op recovery/input changes. The notes also say the intermittent Night 5 freeze remains under investigation; cross-network co-op and sustained performance remain active test areas.

app-pocket-dj.seoTitle: Pocket DJ live remix deck for Chordsmith songs
app-pocket-dj.intro: Pocket DJ is an early browser performance prototype that turns Pocket Chordsmith songs into a live remix deck. Import a song export, launch sections from pads, mute stems, loop bars and shape effects as the track plays.

details.heading: A performance companion
details.text: Import Pocket Chordsmith share codes or project JSON and turn song sections into performance pads. Mute parts, loop bars, build tension, drop back in and launch sections live. Write the song in Chordsmith, then perform it here.

details.heading: Prototype and platform status
details.text: Pocket DJ is an early HTML5 performance prototype. It runs in a browser; a native Android release has not been established.

faqs.question: What can Pocket DJ import?
faqs.answer: Pocket Chordsmith share codes and project JSON.

faqs.question: Does it replace Pocket Chordsmith?
faqs.answer: No. Make the song in Chordsmith, then use Pocket DJ as its live-performance companion.

relatedLabels.app-pocket-chordsmith: Compose a song in Pocket Chordsmith
relatedLabels.app-pocket-audio-handoff: Transfer songs with Pocket Audio Handoff

app-pocket-daw.seoTitle: Pocket DAW Windows music arrangement alpha
app-pocket-daw.intro: Pocket DAW is a Windows desktop music-workflow alpha. Import Pocket Chordsmith songs, arrange audio and MIDI, record takes and export WAV, MIDI or game-audio ZIPs.

details.heading: Arrange, record and compare
details.text: Version 0.6.59 adds Campfire Acoustic, finite Hear this bit auditions and Finish & Compare. Prepare an edit without autoplay, compare the same passage at matched levels, then apply, discard or undo it. Native recording, audio/MIDI take lanes, project media collection and optional VST3 hosting support the arrangement workflow.

details.heading: Export for listening or a game
details.text: Export WAV and MIDI, stems, section loops, or Godot and Web game-audio ZIPs. The native DAW pack follows the arranged timeline, including recording media, effects, automation and tails. Check WAV provides measured delivery guidance; target-game audio and timing still need testing in the game.

details.heading: Windows alpha
details.text: Pocket DAW remains an early Windows alpha. Keep backups of important projects and verify exports before delivery. The installer has an updater signature but is not Windows Authenticode signed, so Windows may show a warning. Get it through the established itch download or the official GitHub release.

faqs.question: Which operating system does Pocket DAW support?
faqs.answer: Pocket DAW is an installed Windows desktop application. Pocket Chordsmith and Pocket DJ are separate browser apps.

faqs.question: Does it export game-audio packs?
faqs.answer: Yes. The current release exports Godot and Web game-audio ZIPs, alongside WAV, MIDI, stems and section loops. Check the imported music and its timing in your target game. This DAW release does not update the separately distributed Godot addon.

updates.dateMeaning: GitHub release publication date in Australia/Sydney
updates.title: 0.6.59 - Campfire, comparison and updater fixes
updates.summary: Campfire Acoustic, finite passage auditions and Finish & Compare join native recording and export workflows. Warm playback reuses resident audio, stale starts are cancelled, and Undo/Redo keeps the export controls in view. This release also patches the native updater dependency and keeps background update checks from replacing active controls.

updates.title: 0.6.50 — Track Sounds and Playback Recovery
updates.summary: Melody instrument changes now apply across the whole track and persist through save and reopen. Native stem rendering moves to a background worker, and playback can recover when a decoded asset has been evicted from cache.

relatedLabels.app-pocket-chordsmith: Start a song in Pocket Chordsmith
relatedLabels.app-pocket-audio-handoff: Move song data with Pocket Audio Handoff

game-breakfast-beat-down.seoTitle: Breakfast Beat-down: Rush Hour Remix browser game
game-breakfast-beat-down.intro: Breakfast Beat-down is a rhythm-action roguelite set in Sunny’s breakfast world. In v0.2: Rush Hour Remix, grab a spatula, move through crowded kitchens and time attacks to the beat, offbeat and melody. Play the portrait-first browser game here.

details.heading: Serve a special on the beat
details.text: Gold circles mark the main beat, mint diamonds mark offbeats, and purple notes follow the lead melody. Timed attacks build groove and score. Four offbeat FLIPs unleash Backbeat Blast; six consecutive melody FLIPs, including two between main beats, fire Hook Shot.

details.heading: Three shifts, twenty-four waves
details.text: Fight through The Sunny Side, The Midnight Freezer and The Boiler Room, with eight waves in each stage. Crowded packs and finite boss support crews increase the pressure. Crumbs buy equipment for the current run; sugar buys permanent upgrades in The Pantry.

details.heading: Touch controls and keyboard play
details.text: Use the left joystick to move, FLIP to attack and SLIP to dodge on a touch screen. On a keyboard, use WASD or the arrow keys to move, J or Space to attack, K or Shift to dodge, and Escape or P to pause. Start a Shift enables browser audio. Portrait is the intended phone orientation.

details.heading: Four original Pocket Chordsmith compositions
details.text: The game contains four embedded Pocket Chordsmith projects. Sound & timing offers separate music and effects volumes, input calibration, wider timing windows, reduced motion, reduced flashes and low-effects mode. The soundtrack menu lets you listen and export the music projects.

faqs.question: Where is progress saved?
faqs.answer: Pantry upgrades and settings are saved in this browser on this site. Storage is not shared automatically between sites or devices. Use The Pantry’s export and import controls to move progress from another build, and keep an exported backup if browser storage is blocked.

faqs.question: How is this related to Breakfast Beat?
faqs.answer: Breakfast Beat-down is the rhythm-action sequel in the breakfast world. The original Breakfast Beat has its own page and tower-defence gameplay.

updates.title: Rush Hour Remix joins Samfa12.com
updates.summary: The v0.2: Rush Hour Remix build is now hosted in the Samfa12 browser game catalogue. This portrait-first rhythm-action roguelite is a sequel to Breakfast Beat, with beat-timed spatula combat across three shifts and 24 waves.

relatedLabels.game-breakfast-beat: Explore the original Breakfast Beat tower-defence game

game-banana-banana-ducky.seoTitle: Banana Banana Ducky! — play the cartoon duck chase
game-banana-banana-ducky.intro: A banana. A red tie. A very silly plan. In Banana Banana Ducky! v1.1, chase and hug every real yellow duck before the clock runs out. Your new friends put on red ties and help recruit the rest of the flock. Play here in your browser with touch controls or a keyboard.

details.heading: Make friends, then become a duck
details.text: Steer Banana Boy, hold HUG! to recruit nearby ducks, and swap into a recruited duck while Banana Boy keeps helping. Each duck keeps its own trick, from flying and burrowing to decoys and a rallying quack. Use Your flock to choose a friend or give a chase command. Fake clones do not count toward the goal.

details.heading: Four worlds, plenty of banana mischief
details.text: Pondside Park, Blossom Grove, The Cheese Moon and The Backyard are all available from the start. Choose the difficulty and round length separately. Gold bananas help, stone bananas are a gamble, and a rainbow banana has a 40% chance to appear during a round. Winners celebrate with a silly dance party.

details.heading: Play with two thumbs or a keyboard
details.text: On a touch screen, drag the left movement stick and use HUG!, the purple trick button and the swap button with your other thumb. On a keyboard, move with WASD or arrow keys, hug with Space, use a trick with E and swap with Q. Escape pauses. Start a round to enable browser audio; music and effects have separate volume controls.

details.heading: A browser game with local settings
details.text: The game requires WebGL 2. Choose Light picture quality in Settings if your device needs a simpler render. Settings and world victory counts save in this browser where local storage is available. An unfinished round does not save. There are no accounts, adverts or purchases, and the game runtime uses no external libraries or network services.

faqs.question: Can I play on iPad?
faqs.answer: The game includes a touch joystick and action buttons, with portrait and landscape layouts. It requires a browser with WebGL 2. Desktop and emulated tablet browser checks are part of this integration; physical iPad performance and Safari compatibility still need hands-on testing.

faqs.question: Will my saved progress move between devices?
faqs.answer: Settings and world victories stay in this browser on this site. They do not transfer automatically between devices or from another host. Clearing browser storage removes them.

updates.title: v1.1 joins Samfa12.com
updates.summary: Banana Banana Ducky! v1.1 is now hosted in the Samfa12 browser game catalogue. Recruit ducks into a flock, switch characters and chase through four playful worlds with touch or keyboard controls.

game-towtal-chaos.seoTitle: Towtal Chaos - play the caravan parking game
game-towtal-chaos.intro: Towtal Chaos is a caravan parking game about small steering inputs and very large trailers. Take the wheel of a 4WD, ute or SUV, manage your hitch angle, and guide the caravan into its marked bay without giving the spectators too much to laugh about. The playable alpha is available on itch.io.

details.heading: Eight stops, four towing setups
details.text: Park through eight challenges, from a roomy holiday park arrival to tight campsites and repair workshops. Choose between compact campers, touring caravans and large tandem-axle rigs. Get the caravan fully inside the marked bay, facing the right way, then stop and apply the parking brake.

details.heading: Choose your pace
details.text: Challenge mode scores your parking; Relaxed mode gives you room to practise; Sandbox lets you explore freely. Earn stars and cash, unlock challenges and watch the repair bills. An optional parking helper offers alignment guidance, ghost positioning and direction indicators.

details.heading: Keyboard or touch controls
details.text: On desktop, A/D or left/right arrows steer, W accelerates, and S or Space brakes. Select Drive with Shift+D, Reverse with R and Neutral with N when nearly stationary. P applies the parking brake and Escape pauses. On touch screens, use the steering wheel, pedals and gear buttons; pinch and rotate with two fingers to adjust the camera.

details.heading: Play in your browser
details.text: Open the official itch.io page to play the HTML5 alpha in a desktop or mobile browser. Progress saves locally in that browser. An internet connection is required to load the 3D engine.

faqs.question: Where can I play Towtal Chaos?
faqs.answer: Play the browser alpha on itch.io, with desktop or touch controls.

faqs.question: Can I play offline or move my progress between devices?
faqs.answer: An internet connection is needed to load the 3D engine. Progress is stored locally in the browser where you play and does not automatically transfer to another device or host.

updates.title: Playable alpha arrives on itch.io
updates.summary: Play the HTML5 caravan-parking alpha on itch.io. It has eight parking challenges, four towing setups and Challenge, Relaxed and Sandbox modes, with keyboard and touch controls. Progress saves locally in the browser; an internet connection is needed to load the 3D engine.

game-reef-sweep.seoTitle: Reef Sweep · Full campaign on Wavedash
game-reef-sweep.intro: Take your skiff out from Lantern Bay and dive beneath the waves. Hunt invasive lionfish, help the reef recover, then bring your catch home to prepare. Between dives, get to know the people who call the bay home. Play free in your browser on Wavedash.

details.heading: Dive into the reef
details.text: Choose a dive site, head out in your skiff and look for lionfish among the coral. Keep an eye on your air, aim your pole spear and secure your catch before returning to the boat.

details.heading: Bring your catch home
details.text: Back ashore, prepare your catch and decide what to do with it. There is always another reason to head back out on the water.

details.heading: Meet Lantern Bay
details.text: Make a home on the coast and get to know the people of Lantern Bay between dives.

faqs.question: Where can I play Reef Sweep?
faqs.answer: Play the full game free in your browser on Wavedash.

faqs.question: Where is my progress saved?
faqs.answer: The Wavedash game has its own progress. Moving saves between devices has not been verified.

faqs.question: How do I control the game?
faqs.answer: Use keyboard and mouse, touch controls or a controller. Performance and compatibility vary by device and browser.

faqs.question: Can I play on my phone?
faqs.answer: Reef Sweep is a browser game on Wavedash. Performance and compatibility vary by device and browser.

faqs.question: Is the game finished?
faqs.answer: The full campaign is free to play on Wavedash. The earlier Samfa12.com demo has been retired.

updates.title: Full campaign arrives on Wavedash
updates.summary: The full Lantern Bay campaign is available on Wavedash. The earlier website demo has since been retired; its old link now takes you to the full game.
updates.platform: Wavedash browser campaign; separate early website demo

updates.title: v0.5.0-preview.3 — crew, water entry and lionfish display
updates.summary: The website demo added a crewed skiff, a short dive entry, new sounds and more lifelike lionfish. Sam tested and approved the changes; phone performance had not been verified.

updates.title: v0.5 expedition preview and portrait refinements
updates.summary: The early demo added skiff trips, keepsakes, catch preparation and later reef conservation work. Phone performance and natural campaign pacing had not yet been verified.

game-reef-sweep.demoNotice: Play the full game free in your browser on Wavedash.
game-reef-sweep.metaDescription: Dive for lionfish, help restore the reef and find a home in Lantern Bay. Play Reef Sweep free in your browser on Wavedash.

technicalDetails.heading: Explore Lantern Bay in the current demo
technicalDetails.text: Drive your diving skiff across the bay, follow the navigation chart and slow beside a gold buoy to choose a dive. A pilot and diver ride aboard the Blender-authored skiff, with swells, buoyancy, wake and bow spray. At a dive buoy, the diver checks their gear and rolls backward into the water before the chosen reef loads. Skip the entry when you want to get straight to the dive; Steady camera skips the sequence too. Underneath are five authored sites: Sunlit Gardens, Tideglass Passage, Mangrove Reach, Azure Cenote and Rusted Harbour. Their ledges, roots, limestone basins and old structures offer different routes. Playable reefs retain clear water, with distance haze beyond their boundaries.

technicalDetails.heading: Hunt lionfish and restore the reef
technicalDetails.text: The remodeled lionfish have striped bodies, broad fans and long dorsal spines. Their defensive display flares as you approach and relaxes when you retreat. Identify a lionfish, draw the pole spear and release a careful strike. The actual fish stays on the spear until you guide it into the catch tube. Spear a second before stashing for a Shishkabob moment in the existing automatic-photo highlights. Larger fish have restaurant value; smaller targets still count towards eradication. Remove abandoned gear, plant coral and survey the reef. Marlow, the named grouper, makes his home in Sunlit Gardens. Ordinary sea stars, lobsters and large sponges bring quieter corners to life.

technicalDetails.heading: A reason to come back
technicalDetails.text: Permanent reef work stays done. Find five authored keepsake charms and clip a favourite beneath the spear grip. Later progression introduces marked crown-of-thorns outbreaks: position the treatment tool, release its safety and apply the fictional treatment for a conservation bounty. Every third game day still brings the local Sweep event, and automatically captured highlights build your in-game audience.

technicalDetails.heading: Better gear and night dives
technicalDetails.text: Spend your earnings on fins, a better spear, more air and a battery-powered scooter. Nine equipment types have five upgrade levels each, giving you more room to explore as your diving business grows. Later equipment service gets cheaper as you gain field experience. The scooter’s motor rises with your thrust and quietens when you stow it. Upgrade your regulator to level 2. Head torches become available on game day 4 with six conservation reputation; fit one and unlock Tideglass Passage to try a night dive. Keep an eye out for the reef shark. High graphics adds shadows across the reef, including those cast by your torch; reload when prompted to apply the full detail.

technicalDetails.heading: Check your dive watch
technicalDetails.text: Raise your wrist to check air, depth, time, secured catch, battery and return reserve. Press V, tap Watch or use your controller mapping. Portrait retains the dive-stat display; landscape frees the view for the watch. Breaching leaves draining droplets on the goggles. A forceful wildlife impact can partly flood the mask; clear it with Interact or the accessible button at a small air cost.

technicalDetails.heading: Prepare your catch
technicalDetails.text: At the harbour, try optional 3D scaling and three guided fillet cuts, then cook citrus pan fish or harbour coconut stew. Filleting adds a quality bonus to fish sold; a prepared meal offsets a small extra expense when a fish is kept. Allocate the catch and select up to two automatic highlight images before settling. Towing and boat fuel appear separately on the receipt and depend on the trip distances.

technicalDetails.heading: Play your way
technicalDetails.text: Use WASD and mouse on desktop, or steer and swim with the touch stick. Hold and drag Draw to aim, then release to strike. Portrait and landscape use distinct, comfortable action buttons. Controllers retain the Backbone preset and calibration guide. New saves start on High graphics; existing choices remain saved. Sustained slow gameplay can offer a lower preset, with Apply and Not now. Fullscreen appears where supported; Wavedash provides its own control.

technicalDetails.heading: Music that follows the dive
technicalDetails.text: The original score, “Room for Life,” uses sounds adapted from Pocket Chordsmith. Music starts after your first menu interaction and continues through boat travel and diving. The boat motor responds to speed, while the score changes with wildlife and danger. Sound settings stay saved, including mute; pausing or leaving the tab quietens the appropriate sounds.
